info:
In this song, we are running three plugins simultaneously: fill reads from the Chart and places SingleNotes for the Chart mode (Scale), arpeggio looks at NamedNotes in the Song which are Chart chords and arpeggiates, and transpose goes up chromatically, on every Song-loop. (Note: 6add9 is exactly major pentatonic, so you won't see extra scale notes for that chord.)

So you can use this song for both Chord practice and Mode practice. Play with the show/hide options per note type in View, and save those DisplayOptions in the first Section. You can either make SingleNotes hidden, or you can turn off FillPlugin with /fpfE Enable , and clear its notes with /fpfC Clear

To be able to reset both the transposition and the arpeggio positions at once, map spacebar to "Reset song hard" with /fmZ Z reset song hard

Raise plugin state: transpose.Chromatic
Raise plugin state: fill.SingleNotesScale
Raise plugin state: arpeggio.NamedNotes-AllHighlight-Positions
